description: Neon provides managed Postgres-based backend services including branching databases, authentication, realtime, object storage, serverless functions, a Data API, and an AI Gateway. It is aimed at developers building applications and AI agents on hosted cloud infrastructure.
summary: Neon exposes a REST management API, a hosted MCP server, and the Neon CLI; docs also describe product-specific endpoints for Data API, AI Gateway, Object Storage, Realtime, and Functions, but their concrete tenant URLs are branch-specific and not published as global developer surfaces on neon.com.
